trigger_scope: AI systems generating synthetic audio/image/video/text within Article 50(2)
requirement_candidate: Implement the Article 50(2) machine-readable marking/detectability requirement for in-scope synthetic outputs
evidence_required: Output samples; marking/detectability test results; model/system version linkage; exception analysis
technical_control_candidate: Synthetic-output provenance/marking and detectability verification control
limitations: Legacy systems described by Article 111(4) have transition until 2026-12-02; exact exceptions and technical feasibility wording control

trigger_scope: GPAI model classified as having systemic risk and within Article 55
requirement_candidate: Perform required model evaluation including adversarial testing under Article 55
evidence_required: Evaluation plan; adversarial-test cases/results; evaluator identity; remediation records; version linkage
technical_control_candidate: Repeatable adversarial-evaluation pipeline with release gating and evidence retention
limitations: Systemic-risk classification and exact Article 55 testing standard must be established separately; no universal test suite inferred

trigger_scope: GPAI model classified as having systemic risk and within Article 55 cybersecurity scope
requirement_candidate: Implement cybersecurity protection measures required by Article 55 for the model and relevant infrastructure
evidence_required: Threat model; access-control evidence; security test results; vulnerability/remediation records; monitoring evidence
technical_control_candidate: Model/infrastructure security control baseline with adversarial testing vulnerability handling and monitoring
limitations: Article 55 does not by itself prescribe one OWASP control set; candidate control vocabulary remains destination-review material
